einzeiler: Dolph Lundgren on his career, plus current news from California and Hollywood.
kurzfassung: Actor Dolph Lundgren discusses his life, career, and recent projects. The episode also covers various news stories from California. Additionally, local events and announcements are shared.
stichpunkte: Dolph Lundgren on his career and action films
Helicopter crash during news reporting in Los Angeles
Ed Sheeran tour updates and opener departures
Federal investigation into a Los Angeles homeless scheme
Suspension of a California high school football team
beschreibung:
Dolph Lundgren is a Swedish actor, filmmaker, and martial artist best known for playing the imposing Soviet boxer Ivan Drago in Rocky IV (1985). He went on to star in action films including Universal Soldier, The Expendables franchise, and Aquaman, establishing himself as one of Hollywood's most recognizable action stars. Check out his new documentary ‘Dolph: Unbreakable’ out on October 6th and his new book ‘Fights Worth Fighting: Finding Strength In Struggle’ out on September 22nd.

IN THE NEWS: L.A. and California state officials say Paramount Studios is leaving California, 3 dead after a news helicopter reporting for NBC Los Angeles crashes while covering a fatal bus collision, all of Ed Sheeran’s openers—including Finneas—ditch the tour after the Macklemore fiasco, feds smash a multimillion-dollar L.A. homeless scheme as a bigwig and “charity” worker are dragged from their homes, and an entire California high school football team is suddenly suspended as disturbing claims emerge.
